$comment: Check Control (CC-ID) messages: the dash warnings with the triangle. Written in Klemme15's own words from community lists (sources per entry). 'high' = the community meaning agrees with a local cross-check of BMW's cluster text table (where they differ, BMW's numbering is used and the entry has a 'note'); 'medium' = community lists only (the public lists are copies of one list, so this is a single source). 'module' is the module that usually raises the message. BMW's own texts are never included; when the user has their BMW files, Klemme15 shows BMW's wording next to these. Severity follows the triangle colour: Critical = red (stop safely), Warning and Advisory = yellow. IDs are for E8x/E9x/E6x/E7x clusters; other models can differ.
